name: Huawei · Intelligent Automotive Solution BU
Huawei · 华为智能汽车解决方案 BU
body: Designed experiences for intelligent cockpit HMI, desktop cards and assistants. Defined 12 atomic and 11 composite component groups, including properties, usage rules and design-to-code mapping.
Explored AI-assisted delivery workflows, competitive products and interaction patterns for cockpit cards, assistants and connected ordering.
参与智能座舱 HMI、智能桌面及助手体验设计。梳理 12 组原子组件与 11 组复合组件，定义属性、使用规则及设计到代码的映射；探索 AI 辅助设计工作流。
参与智能桌面卡片、助手及联动点餐等场景的竞品分析、流程梳理与界面设计。

name: Elihome · Milan
Elihome · Milan
body: Designed EliLab, an internal research library spanning 3 departments and 11 research areas. Structured information architecture, classification and retrieval around 4 research workflows.
Developed the interface and design guidelines to support a consistent internal research experience.
设计 EliLab 内部研究资料库，覆盖 3 个部门、11 个研究领域。围绕 4 类研究工作流建立信息架构、分类检索体验与界面规范。
进一步完成界面设计与使用规范，支持内部研究资料的持续积累与调用。

name: Perfects AI
Perfects AI
body: Contributed to a B2B and B2C AI agent platform from the ground up: agent creation, knowledge integration, multi-model access and permissions.
Separately led 4 designers on an overseas-study assistance product, including AI résumé improvement and 4 other modules. Kept product architecture, interface design and delivery connected.
参与面向 ToB 与 ToC 的 AI 智能体平台从 0 到 1 设计，涵盖智能体创建、知识库接入、多模型调用与权限体系。另负责留学辅助产品的 AI 简历优化等 5 个模块，带领 4 位设计师推进设计交付。
将产品架构、界面设计与交付衔接；智能体平台与留学辅助产品分别呈现。

name: Burson · WPP
Burson · WPP
body: Created media roadbooks, covers and event visuals for Ford, including reusable layout templates across four roadbook editions.
Supported visual strategy proposals for CATL, Genesis and Mercedes-Benz, translating brand narratives into presentation systems.
参与福特纵横野系列媒体路书、活动海报及品牌提案。建立可复用版式模板，并支持宁德时代、捷尼赛思及梅赛德斯-奔驰相关视觉方案。
围绕品牌叙事整理视觉提案与演示材料，支持跨团队协作。

body: Worked on digital exhibitions, VR and interactive urban-planning experiences, including projects in Wuxi, Yiwu, Suzhou and Rui’an.
Collaborated with engineers on an AI design innovation concept.
参与数字展厅、VR 与城市规划互动项目，联合工程师推进 AI 设计创新方案。
项目涉及无锡、义乌、苏州与瑞安的数字空间和互动体验。

生态设计研究
body: Co-authored “An Ecological Design Approach in the Context of Posthumanism and Situationism”, exploring ecological design through posthumanist and situationist perspectives.

body: Designed a service connecting ocean-plastic recovery with sustainable products for rental or purchase. Encouraged fishers and beach visitors to participate in cleanup, supporting local production and responsible tourism. Awarded a national Third Prize in the 2024 Milan Design Week China University Design Exhibition.
将海洋塑料转化为可租赁或购买的可持续产品，鼓励渔民与游客参与清理，支持本地产业与负责任的旅游。获 2024 年米兰设计周—中国高校设计学科师生优秀作品展全国三等奖。

title: AI in Healthcare · Industry Field Research
智能医疗时代 · AI 产业实践
body: Conducted field research at United Imaging Healthcare and 宝藤生物 (Baoteng Biotechnology). Synthesized interviews and case studies on AI applications, business models and industry trends, and developed recommendations around industry-chain strengths and cloud services. Recognized as an Outstanding Individual in undergraduate industry practice.
实地走访联影医疗与宝藤生物，整理案例与访谈材料，分析 AI 医疗应用、商业模式与行业趋势，探讨产业链优势及云服务的市场机会。获本科生产业实践优秀个人。

title: Thirty Years of Reforestation · Yan’an
延安市退耕还林三十年的绩效评价
body: Coordinated with the local forestry bureau and arranged field interviews. Wrote and published project reports on the ecological, economic and social effects of reforestation. The team received a Second Prize for undergraduate social practice.
对接当地林业局，协调访问与实地访谈；撰写发布通讯稿，传播退耕还林政策对生态、经济与民生影响的研究成果。获本科生社会实践优秀团队二等奖。
